claims.text: Finasteride 5 mg once a day alone
claims.quote: The recommended dose of PROSCAR is one tablet (5 mg) taken once a day
The recommended dose of PROSCAR is one tablet (5 mg) taken once a day in combination with the alpha-blocker doxazosin
PROSCAR may be administered with or without meals.

claims.text: Dutasteride 0.5 mg once daily (with tamsulosin 0.4 mg once daily in combination).
claims.quote: The recommended dose of AVODART is 1 capsule (0.5 mg) taken once daily and tamsulosin 0.4 mg taken once daily.

claims.text: Swallow whole: the capsule contents may irritate the oropharyngeal mucosa.
claims.quote: The capsules should be swallowed whole and not chewed or opened, as contact with the capsule contents may result in irritation of the oropharyngeal mucosa.

claims.text: Finasteride lowers PSA by about 50% within six months.
claims.quote: PROSCAR reduced serum PSA concentration by approximately 50% within six months of treatment.
claims.locator: 5.1 Effects on Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA) and the Use of PSA in Prostate Cancer Detection

claims.text: Set a new PSA baseline at least six months in and monitor periodically; any confirmed rise from the lowest value may signal prostate cancer and should be evaluated, even within the normal range.
claims.quote: a new PSA baseline should be established at least six months after starting treatment and PSA monitored periodically thereafter. Any confirmed increase from the lowest PSA value while on PROSCAR may signal the presence of prostate cancer and should be evaluated, even if PSA levels are still within the normal range for men not taking a 5α-reductase inhibitor.
claims.locator: 5.1 Effects on Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA) and the Use of PSA in Prostate Cancer Detection

claims.text: An isolated PSA after six months or more: double it to compare with normal ranges.
claims.quote: To interpret an isolated PSA value in patients treated with PROSCAR for six months or more, PSA values should be doubled for comparison with normal ranges in untreated men.
claims.locator: 5.1 Effects on Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA) and the Use of PSA in Prostate Cancer Detection

claims.text: Before starting, consider other urological conditions that cause similar symptoms; prostate cancer and BPH may coexist.
claims.quote: Prior to initiating treatment with PROSCAR, consideration should be given to other urological conditions that may cause similar symptoms. In addition, prostate cancer and BPH may coexist.

claims.text: Large residual urine volume or severely diminished flow: monitor carefully for obstructive uropathy.
claims.quote: Patients with large residual urinary volume and/or severely diminished urinary flow should be carefully monitored for obstructive uropathy.

claims.text: Finasteride tablets are coated, which prevents contact during normal handling unless they are broken or crushed;
claims.quote: PROSCAR tablets are coated and will prevent contact with the active ingredient during normal handling, provided that the tablets have not been broken or crushed.
claims.locator: 5.3 Exposure of Females — Risk to Male Fetus

claims.text: a pregnant woman who touches crushed or broken tablets should wash the area right away with soap and water.
claims.quote: If a pregnant female comes in contact with crushed or broken PROSCAR tablets, the contact area should be washed immediately with soap and water.
claims.locator: 5.3 Exposure of Females — Risk to Male Fetus

claims.text: The same applies to leaking dutasteride capsules.
claims.quote: If a pregnant woman comes in contact with leaking dutasteride capsules, the contact area should be washed immediately with soap and water
claims.locator: 5.4 Transdermal Exposure of AVODART in Pregnant Women—Risk to Male Fetus

claims.text: Finasteride: no drug interactions of clinical importance identified.
claims.quote: No drug interactions of clinical importance have been identified.
claims.locator: 7.1 Cytochrome P450-Linked Drug Metabolizing Enzyme System

claims.text: Dutasteride: caution with potent, chronic CYP3A4 inhibitors (eg, ritonavir).
claims.quote: use caution when prescribing AVODART to patients taking potent, chronic CYP3A4 enzyme inhibitors (e.g., ritonavir)
